$description: The site's two shadow recipes, stored as layers because that is Penpot's own shape — offsetX / offsetY / blur / spread / color, with 8-digit hex so the alpha travels. Both are two-layer (tight contact plus wide soft) and go deeper on dark. `panel` lifts the mega-menu; `popup` is the same recipe scaled down for the place-map popup. tailwind.config.js composes the layers into --box-shadow-*; build-penpot-tokens.js emits panel/popup into theme/light and the -dark pair into theme/dark under the same names.
